sample_unit: standardized breast cancer questions (each queried in three iterations)

links.outcome: Readability grade level (FKGL) of LLM breast cancer patient education answers vs 6th-grade threshold
links.effect: Gemini FKGL 9.23 vs ChatGPT 10.07 (q = 0.022); both exceeded the 6th-grade threshold; treatment queries raised complexity (ChatGPT FKGL q = 0.012; Gemini q = 0.047).
links.quote: Gemini had better readability than ChatGPT (FKGL 9.23 vs 10.07, q = 0.022); both exceeded the 6th-grade threshold.

links.outcome: Reading level of AI-generated patient materials relative to appropriate patient reading level
links.effect: Both LLMs exceeded the 6th-grade threshold (FKGL 9.23 Gemini, 10.07 ChatGPT), with readability declining for treatment questions.
links.quote: Gemini had better readability than ChatGPT (FKGL 9.23 vs 10.07, q = 0.022); both exceeded the 6th-grade threshold.

links.outcome: Cross-iteration stability of LLM responses to identical questions (ICC)
links.effect: Cross-iteration ICC values were poor-to-moderate for both models (mean ICC: ChatGPT = 0.58, Gemini = 0.59).
links.quote: Cross-iteration ICC values were poor-to-moderate for both models (mean ICC: ChatGPT = 0.58, Gemini = 0.59).

screen.reason: Evaluates the readability and linguistic complexity of ChatGPT and Gemini responses to standardized breast cancer questions, finding they exceed recommended readability levels.
